text: # Onessta — overview Onessta (onessta.com) is a Moroccan affiliate + delivery platform co-founded by Med, CTO since December 2023. It started in 2022 as a small delivery system, then evolved into affiliation tightly linked to delivery. Affiliates register, browse a marketplace, and add orders. Confirmation agents and a manager handle everything through to final delivery, all on one platform. Stack: Laravel 13, PHP 8.3+, Velzon admin template with Blade and Bootstrap 5. Infrastructure: Contabo and IONOS VPS.

# Onessta — affiliate flow Affiliates register on Onessta, browse the marketplace, and add orders for products they want to sell. They do not handle stock, confirmation, or delivery themselves. Once an order is added, confirmation agents contact the customer, confirm the order, and pass it to delivery. The affiliate earns a margin-based commission. Commission is computed at delivery, not at order creation. If the order is not delivered, there is no commission.

# Onessta — delivery operations Delivery operations on Onessta cover admin, HR and employee management, stock agents, CRM, couriers, courier partners, and partner platforms. The platform also exposes APIs with documentation for partners. Integrations include Google Sheets, Shopify, Youcan, and WooCommerce. The delivery flow is: affiliate order, confirmation, preparation, courier assignment, delivery, then commission calculation.

# Cursor SDK — Jira automation (planned, not built yet) This is the target automation for Phase 3, not something already running. The idea: when a new task is created in Jira and tagged cursor-ai, a webhook fires. A new agent starts coding on that task, then creates a new commit and opens a pull request. The flow is: Jira webhook, new agent start coding, new commit, pull request. This is event-driven orchestration: Jira webhook to agent to commit to PR. It is the automation Phase 1 is building towards — first learn the ReAct loop, then automate with the Cursor SDK.

# OpenClaw — target setup (not installed yet) OpenClaw is not installed yet. This doc describes what it will do in Phase 3. When a message comes in, the OpenClaw Gateway normalizes it, assembles context, runs inference, executes tools in a ReAct loop, and persists memory. OpenClaw is the conversational entry point. In Phase 3, an OpenClaw skill will trigger the Cursor SDK automation: message OpenClaw, it creates a Jira task, tags it cursor-ai, the Cursor agent codes, commits, opens a PR, and OpenClaw reports back with the PR link.

# Demo — Agent Email Intelligent Agent Email Intelligent is one of Med's five GenAI demo projects. It is an intelligent email agent that reads, triages, and drafts replies. It shows agentic behaviour: it decides what an email needs, calls tools to find context, and produces a draft. It is part of Med's GenAI automation portfolio, alongside invoice processing and document intelligence.

# Demo — Smart Invoice Processor Smart Invoice Processor is one of Med's five GenAI demo projects. It processes invoices intelligently, extracting structured data from documents. Related work is the ADI invoice pipeline: in PHP with laravel/ai and laravel-swarm, and in Python with LangChain and CrewAI, at scaffolding stage. The demo shows document understanding plus structured extraction, a classic RAG and agent use case.

# Demo — Agent Document Intelligence Agent Document Intelligence is one of Med's five GenAI demo projects. It answers questions and extracts insight from documents, using retrieval to ground answers in the source files. This is a RAG demo at its core: the system knows things from documents, retrieves relevant passages, and generates answers from them, rather than relying only on the model's training data.

# Demo — Systeme Multi-Agents Collaboratifs The Multi-Agent Collaborative System is one of Med's five GenAI demo projects. Several agents collaborate: one researches, one writes, one reviews, for example. This is multi-agent orchestration. In the roadmap, Phase 2 uses LangGraph for this, because it gives explicit state machines and cycles, preferred for production work in 2026 over looser frameworks.

# Demo — Plateforme GenAI avec Modeles Locaux + Cloud Hybride The GenAI Platform with Local and Cloud Hybrid Models is one of Med's five GenAI demo projects. It runs models locally and in the cloud, choosing where to run each task. Local models use Ollama and ChromaDB in Med's structured track. Cloud models include OpenAI and Claude. The hybrid approach balances cost, privacy, and latency: local for private data, cloud for heavy reasoning.
